messages:
samir: Hey team — PTAL on PR #4823. I addressed the earlier comments: removed the deprecated config flag, split the big test, and added a quick smoke script.

maya: thanks! glancing now. can you show the smoke command?

samir: sure — run:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --quick --target routing
```
I also added test names `smoke_routing_quick` and `unit_routing_split`.

maya: nice. one small nit: the log message in route_manager still uses "old-fallback" string, can you rename to "fallback-v2"?

samir: good catch — renamed and pushed. ran unit + smoke locally.

jordan: LMK results of perf runs? staging trace looked noisy earlier.

samir: ran 3 perf runs on staging (payload sim). avg tail latency down ~6%, median stable. upload: https://internal.ci/redwood/artifacts/4823/perf.log

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed (build #789) :white_check_mark:

ops-merge-bot: Canary window available 2024-05-02 18:00 UTC. Reply with `merge please` to trigger merge and canary deploy.

maya: :thumbsup: good to go from my side.

samir: merge please

ops-merge-bot: Merged PR #4823 into main and scheduled canary deploy. Notifying release channel.

maya: thanks!

jordan: great, thx s.
